description: National-Power-Outages: Code to clean and analyze national power outages is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors Do Vivian, Heather McBrien. Power outages threaten public health. While outages will likely increase with climate change, an aging electrical grid, and increased energy demand, little is known about their frequency and distribution within states. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. Formats: TXT. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC BY-SA 4.0. Caveats: written from the Dataverse search and dataset metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
